messages:
Devon: noticed a weird spike in invoice-preview for tenant T-482 — tokens doubled for a ~30s window, no obvious replay
Marta: saw same on console, per-route breakdown shows fallback route 'preview-sku' getting a copy of the original event :thinking_face:
Samir: could be the router duplicating when fallback policy fires. any ingress logs?
Devon: pasted minimal events from edge and ingest (sanitized):

```
// edge emitted
{ \"tenant\": \"T-482\", \"route\": \"primary\", \"tokens\": 120, \"event_id\": \"evt_abc123\", \"trace\": \"span1\" }
// router fallback copy
{ \"tenant\": \"T-482\", \"route\": \"preview-sku\", \"tokens\": 120, \"event_id\": \"evt_abc123-fb\", \"orig_event_id\": \"evt_abc123\" }
```

Marta: that orig_event_id should have prevented double-billing. looks like the tally service doesn't dedupe on orig_event_id
Kevin: current dedupe key for tally is (tenant,event_id) — fallback generates new event_id so it bypasses dedupe entirely
Rachel: OpsBot fired an alert on invoice-preview delta for billing-sandbox at 23:02UTC (small, but reproducible)
OpsBot: [alert] invoice-preview delta for tenant T-482: +120 tokens (duplicate) — suggestion: run /replay-check
Samir: quick patch idea: have the router set a header `x-dedupe-parent: evt_abc123` and have ingest normalize canonical_event_id = x-dedupe-parent || event_id
Marta: we need to be careful — analytics needs to keep the fallback route tag for usage breakdowns. don't want to lose attribution
Devon: agreed. requirements: (1) billing uses canonical id for dedupe, (2) analytics retains route and fallback signals in metadata
Kevin: concrete proposal: ingest adds a field `canonical_event_id` = orig_event_id || event_id; meter (billing) uses canonical_event_id; route attribution for dashboards uses the event.route and event.fallback=true flag
Rachel: UX: console should surface suppressed duplicates in invoice-preview with a small banner + link to reconciliation run so finance isn't surprised
Marta: also add a fallback-copy-rate metric (fallback_copies / inbound_events) for alerting and SLOs
Samir: I'll open a short RFC and a canary PR for ingest normalization. will add unit tests to ensure meter dedupes on canonical_event_id
Devon: can we backfill the affected window? rough calc: ~120 tokens * 1 tenant * ~30s ~= small, but we should fix historical preview diffs
Kevin: backfill script mostly exists; need an owner and a safe window run: 2024-06-14T23:00:00Z -> 2024-06-14T23:05:00Z
Rachel: assigning backfill + finance coord to Samir — please ping finance before running so invoice-preview isn't misleading
Samir: on it. will post PR link and a runbook once tests pass
Marta: follow-up: add an alert when fallback copy ratio > 1% for more than 1 minute, and a dashboard card showing recent canonicalization failures
Devon: agreed. also add an integration test that simulates router fallback and asserts no double-charge in meter
Samir: noted. PR will include test + small runbook. planning canary to `metering-canary` for 1h tomorrow
Rachel: thanks all — happy path: canonical_event_id prevents billing dupes, metadata preserves route for analytics and UX flags duplicates
Devon: thanks team :thumbsup:
